title: Refund Limits Card — Cartwise Grocery Orders
content:
# Refund limits card — Cartwise Grocery Orders

Every Cartwise Grocery Orders service level fixes how long an item issue may be reported, how much the support desk may refund on one order, what rolling limits apply across a customer's orders, when a photo is needed, and where refunds are paid by default.

## Per-order limits

| Service level | Issue-report window after completion | Self-service refund cap (amount) | Self-service refund cap (share of item subtotal) | Photo needed for damaged or quality issues on a line charged above |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Curbside Pickup | 3 calendar days | 50.00 USD | 50 percent | 20.00 USD |
| No-Rush Delivery | 3 calendar days | 50.00 USD | 50 percent | 20.00 USD |
| Standard Delivery | 3 calendar days | 75.00 USD | 50 percent | 20.00 USD |
| Priority Delivery | 3 calendar days | 75.00 USD | 50 percent | 20.00 USD |
| Express 30 Delivery | 2 calendar days | 40.00 USD | 50 percent | 20.00 USD |
| Stock-Up Delivery | 5 calendar days | 150.00 USD | 40 percent | 30.00 USD |

## Rolling limits and refund destination

| Service level | Rolling 90-day refund count limit | Rolling 90-day refund amount limit | Default refund destination |
|---|---|---|---|
| Curbside Pickup | 6 | 150.00 USD | original payment method |
| No-Rush Delivery | 6 | 150.00 USD | original payment method |
| Standard Delivery | 6 | 150.00 USD | original payment method |
| Priority Delivery | 6 | 150.00 USD | original payment method |
| Express 30 Delivery | 6 | 150.00 USD | original payment method |
| Stock-Up Delivery | 6 | 250.00 USD | original payment method |

## Definitions used on this card

- **Issue-report window** — the number of calendar days after completion within which item issues and substitution rejections can be reported.
- **Self-service refund cap (amount)** — the most in item refunds the support desk may grant on one order.
- **Self-service refund cap (share)** — a second per-order cap, a percentage of the order's item subtotal; of the two caps, the lower applies.
- **Rolling 90-day refund count limit** — the number of item refunds across the customer's orders in a rolling 90 days above which new requests go to review.
- **Rolling 90-day refund amount limit** — the item-refund total across the customer's orders in a rolling 90 days above which new requests go to review.
- **Photo threshold** — a damaged or quality refund on a line charged above this amount requires a photo on the case.
- **Default refund destination** — where item and fee refunds go unless the customer asks for Cartwise credit; the other setting is Cartwise credit.

## Reading the two per-order caps (hypothetical orders)

| Hypothetical order | Amount cap | Share cap on the item subtotal | Lower cap |
|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Delivery, item subtotal 120.00 USD | 75.00 | 50 percent of 120.00 is 60.00 | 60.00 |
| Standard Delivery, item subtotal 200.00 USD | 75.00 | 50 percent of 200.00 is 100.00 | 75.00 |
| Stock-Up Delivery, item subtotal 300.00 USD | 150.00 | 40 percent of 300.00 is 120.00 | 120.00 |
